market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$82k on May 6 2026 would need to drop ~39% to $50k by Dec 31. Historical drawdowns of that magnitude in 8 months happen but are unusual outside of major macro/regulatory shocks. May low was ~$78-79k, so spot already off recent lows. ETF flows and institutional support cushion downside.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of recession-driven liquidation or geopolitical risk-off cascade
